data.bottom_line: With several calm days since our last storm, glide avalanches remain the biggest concern. We are seeing widespread glide cracks and glide avalanches across the zone as an active glide cycle continues. While you're out, plan your route to avoid glide cracks, spread out if you need to travel underneath them, and check overhead before stopping for a snack. _________________________________ SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENTS: Forecast Operations: Daily danger ratings for Turnagain Pass begin Saturday, November 28. Weekly danger ratings for Chugach State Park and Summit Lake also begin on Saturday, November 28. On December 2nd and 3rd, the Northern Aspects Film Festival 2026 will be showing at Bear Tooth Theatrepub for its fifth year, celebrating the people, places, and stories that make skiing in Alaska unlike anywhere else. These showings will benefit the Hatcher Pass Avalanche Center and the Valdez Avalanche Center. Hope to see you there! Motorized Winter Access: Turnagain Pass opens to snowmachines on Wednesday, November 25, the day before Thanksgiving, per the CNF Forest plan and the new over-snow vehicle use map ( OSVU map ). The remaining motorized winter riding areas on the Chugach National Forest open December 1. Happy Thanksgiving from all of us at the Chugach National Forest Avalanche Center! We hope you enjoy the snowy holiday.
